# crosswork_golden_config_jobs (Data Source)

This data source can read the devices a Golden Configuration template is applied to, with their conformance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_golden_config_jobs" "example" {
  id = "cwtest-ntp"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object, the template name

### Optional

- `device` (String) Only this device, by inventory id
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) The devices the template is applied to, sorted by name; conformance is the controller's own check, and turns true about 45 seconds after a job (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `template_id` (Number) The integer id the controller gave the template

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `application_name` (String) Name of the application, the template on the device
- `conformant` (Boolean) Whether the device matches the template
- `device_name` (String) Inventory id of the device
- `device_uuid` (String) Uuid of the device
